parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State what is meant by partition coefficient, $K_{pc}$.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
The partition coefficient, $K_{pc}$, for a compound, $\mathbf{X}$, between carbon disulfide, $\text{CS}_2$, and water is 10.5.

$1.85\text{ g}$ of $\mathbf{X}$ is dissolved in water and made up to $100.0\text{ cm}^3$ in a volumetric flask. $40.0\text{ cm}^3$ of this aqueous solution is shaken with $25.0\text{ cm}^3$ of $\text{CS}_2$. The mixture is left to reach equilibrium.

Calculate the mass of $\mathbf{X}$, in g, extracted into the $\text{CS}_2$ layer.
